title: Spectral Resonance Post-Process Mixer
description: An iridescent abalone shell and a translucent skull float side by side, each emitting spectral energy into a shared post-processing pipeline. The user manipulates six coupled post-process effect channels—bloom, chromatic aberration, film grain, vignette, tone-mapping exposure, and color grading hue—where adjusting one channel on the skull redistributes a fixed 'spectral energy budget' across the abalone's channels and vice versa, with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 and the official post-processing stack (import maps from cdn.jsdelivr.net for three, three/addons including EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, ShaderPass, and custom shader passes). Load IridescenceAbalone.glb on the left and ScatteringSkull.glb on the right, both centered at y=0, separated by 3 units. Use a PerspectiveCamera at z=6 with OrbitControls. Add one warm DirectionalLight and one cool HemisphereLight. Build a post-process pipeline with six effect layers: (1) UnrealBloomPass, (2) chromatic aberration ShaderPass, (3) film grain ShaderPass, (4) vignette ShaderPass, (5) exposure tone-mapping ShaderPass, (6) hue-shift color grading ShaderPass. Each effect has intensity 0-1. Implement a conservation law: total energy across all six channels is fixed at 3.0. Create an HTML overlay panel with two columns labeled Abalone and Skull, each showing six sliders (one per effect). When the user drags any slider on the Abalone column, the corresponding Skull slider adjusts inversely so paired values sum to the per-channel budget (0.5 each pair). The final shader uniform equals the weighted blend of both columns. Implement multi-input coupling: holding Shift while dragging locks the ratio between adjacent channel pairs, so moving bloom also moves chromatic aberration proportionally. Maintain an undo/redo history stack (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y) storing full slider state snapshots, capped at 30 entries. Add a Reset button restoring equal 0.25/0.25 distribution. Render both models through the shared EffectComposer so all six post-process effects are visible in real time. Display a small HUD showing current total energy to prove conservation. The task requires at least 10 deliberate slider interactions across both columns plus undo/redo usage to reach a target visual preset shown as a thumbnail reference in the corner.
